notes: The operator identifies the 1.9-mile Western course. Its published plan includes the Western Northern turnaround, central diagonal and inner Southern hairpin, Northern carousel, short Northeastern return and Eastern closing straight. These branches follow the independently inspected graded road alignment in public-domain July 2022 NAIP imagery. The operator construction history dates this period before final paving. The trace is a historical construction-alignment draft; finished pavement centerline, temporary barriers and fine corner alignment are unverified. It excludes the separate Eastern circuit, paddock and access roads. No operator or comparison diagram pixels supply course coordinates, and no coordinates are scaled to a nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 3064.5 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
